text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
"And that concludes this week's<n>Twinkle Series
Highlights! Wooow,<n>this week was another for the
history<n>books!"

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You've just got something special.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You've just got something special.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Talk about makin' your heart skip a<n>beat... Heh,
what am I even talkin'<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh! Better get goin'.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite Inari One's rejection, I can't<n>get her race
out of my mind, even<n>days later... and before I know
it, I've<n>subconsciously made my way back<n>to the
soba restaurant she took me to.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, well, if it isn't the Tracen<n>trainer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Hehehe, you sure are a lucky<n>one, ya know
that? There just so<n>happens to be a huge festival
today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't think ya can leave without<n>checkin' it out!
This is a festival! I<n>want ya to go in, heart ablazin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wahoo! Wahoo! That's more like it!<n>Keep those
festival vibes goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: C'mon, that includes you, too!<n>Wahoo! Wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bam! Bam! Bam!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Graaaugh, you've done it again, Inari!<n>I swear, I
should have ya booked for<n>highway robbery!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! There, now ya got some<n>proper payback!
Now... how's about<n>we continue our crime spree?

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Inari here's the bane of our<n>existence
come festival time! Ah,<n>right, didja hear the diner's
doin'<n>their first stall today?

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
They're sellin' those tasty pickled<n>cucumbers of
theirs, so make sure ya<n>check it out! I'm sure
they'll be<n>thrilled to see ya too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! That's why I'm here in the<n>first place! I'm
gonna buy me 'bout<n>five or ten cukes and give
their stall<n>some good PR!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
That's our Inari! The sweetest<n>Umamusume ya
ever met!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Inariiii! Over here! Over here!<n>Wouldn't you know it?
Our whole<n>team's gathered for the festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzat so? If it's the whole team, then<n>that means...
Ah, hey, Chief! Thanks<n>for the other day.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all. ...Hm? That badge<n>on your
sleeve... Sir, you wouldn't<n>happen to be...
choice_data_list: I-it's very nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all. ...Hm? That badge<n>on your
sleeve... Miss, you wouldn't<n>happen to be...
choice_data_list: I-it's very nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, whatcha so nervous for? Chief<n>don't bite, I
promise. Sure, his face's<n>a li'l rough, but he's a
total softy on<n>the inside!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
I swear, Inari, you always gotta get<n>that extra zinger
in, don'tcha... Sorry<n>about her. I heard you came
here to<n>scout talent, and she caught your eye.
choice_data_list: She did. That race the other day was amazing...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya hear that, Chief?! I wouldn't be<n>half as good as I
am without your<n>training! I'd say you can hold your
head high now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Although, this is just the beginning!<n>I'm gonna win
loads and loads of<n>races and become the new Oi
racing<n>sensation!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Since you're my first national fan,you'll be comin' back for all myraces from now on, right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: This girl... Why's she gotta be so<n>stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break from the festival<n>cheers that only
grow as time goes<n>on, I accompany Inari One to a
nearby<n>shrine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take the last swig of my ramune as I<n>watch Inari
One chow down on her<n>grilled carrot. Interrupting
this tranquil<n>atmosphere, I speak up.
choice_data_list: You really love this town, don't you?
You really love this town, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I do.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This place is part of who I am. I'm<n>only the stylin',
fearless Edo girl I am<n>'cause of the people livin'
here.
choice_data_list: And you've got a pretty great team here, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't I?! Ya really do got an eye for<n>this stuff,
don't—Hey, whoa, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, ya look like a kicked<n>puppy, for cryin'
out loud. Geez...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya musta really liked my runnin'!<n>Almost makes me
wanna show off<n>just for you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, you seriously want a<n>show? Wow, you
gotta be kiddin'<n>me...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But well, an Edo girl never goes back<n>on her word.
All right, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's see... 'Round here should be<n>good. All right...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Watch and be amazed! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Urrrararararaaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Inari One blasts off, undeterred by the<n>terrain. Under
the evening sky, her<n>running form seems even
more<n>powerful.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! Not like I did<n>anythin' special
anyways.
choice_data_list: Your running really is the best!
Your running really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit. How the hell're you sayin'<n>that cheesy
stuff with such a straight<n>face?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (You're makin' me curious about<n>Tracen...)
